rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Disaster Safety Industry Promotion Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Disaster Safety Industry Promotion Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Designation of Professional Training Institutions) ①Any person who intends to bedesignated as a training institution for professional personnel in the disaster safety industry pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Disaster Safety Industry Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “ Act”) shall submit to the Minister of the Interior and Safety or the head of a local government, attaching the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs to the application for designation of a training institution in Form No. 1 attached hereto, pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act (hereinafter referred to asthe “Decree”)
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Designation of Professional Training Institutions) ① Any person who intends to be designated as a training institution for professional personnel in the disaster safety industry pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Disaster Safety Industry Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) shall, pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), submit to the Minister of the Interior and Safety or the head of a local government an application for designation of a training institution in Form No. 1 attached hereto, together with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. Articles of Incorporation or equivalent operating regulations
rows.text_en: 1. Articles of Incorporation or equivalent operating regulations

rows.source_ko: 2. Training implementation plan including curriculum and content
rows.text_en: 2. Training implementation plan including curriculum and content

rows.source_ko: 3. Current Status of Educational Facilities and Equipment
rows.text_en: 3. Current Status of Educational Facilities and Equipment

rows.source_ko: 4. Status of Securing Professional Faculty and Dedicated Operational Staff
rows.text_en: 4. Status of Securing Professional Faculty and Dedicated Operational Staff

rows.source_ko: 5. Operating Expense Financing Plan
rows.text_en: 5. Operating Expense Financing Plan

rows.source_ko: 6. Other documents necessary for the designation of a training institution, as prescribed and notified by the Minister of the Interior and Safety or determined by the ordinance of a local government.
rows.text_en: 6. Other documents necessary for the designation of a training institution, as prescribed and notified by the Minister of the Interior and Safety or determined by the ordinance of a local government.

rows.source_ko: ② The Minister of the Interior and Safety or the head of a local government who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the certificate of corporate registration or business registration certificate through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the business registration certificate, a copy thereof must be attached.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of the Interior and Safety or the head of a local government who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the certificate of corporate registration or business registration certificate through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the business registration certificate, a copy thereof must be attached.

rows.source_ko: ③ When the Minister of the Interior and Safety or the head of a local government designates a training institution pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree, they shall issue a certificate of designation of the training institution in the form of Annex 2 .
rows.text_en: ③ When the Minister of the Interior and Safety or the head of a local government designates a training institution pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree, they shall issue a certificate of designation of the training institution in the form of Annex 2 .

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Designation of Disaster Safety Industry Promotion Facility) ①Any person who intends to be designated as a disaster safety industry promotion facility (hereinafter referred to as “promotion facility”) pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of the Interior and Safety or the head of a local government, in accordance with Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, an application for designation of a promotion facility in Form No. 3 of the Appendix , with attached documents proving that the requirements for designation under each subparagraph of Paragraph 1 of the same Article are met.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Designation of Disaster Safety Industry Promotion Facility) ① Any person who intends to be designated as a disaster safety industry promotion facility (hereinafter referred to as “promotion facility”) pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of the Interior and Safety or the head of a local government, in accordance with Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, an application for designation of a promotion facility in Form No. 3 of the Appendix, with attached documents proving that the requirements for designation under each subparagraph of Paragraph 1 of the same Article are met.

rows.source_ko: ② When the Minister of the Interior and Safety or the head of a local government designates a promotion facility pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the Act , they shall issue a designation certificate for the promotion facility in the form of Annex 4 .
rows.text_en: ② When the Minister of the Interior and Safety or the head of a local government designates a promotion facility pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the Act, they shall issue a designation certificate for the promotion facility in the form of Annex 4.

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Designation of New Disaster Safety Technology, etc.) ①Any person who intends to obtain designation of a new disaster safety technology (hereinafter referred to as “new technology”) pursuant to Article 14 , Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of the Interior and Safety, in accordance with Paragraph 3 of the same Article, an application for designation of new technology in the form of Annex No. 5, with the following documents attached.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Designation of New Disaster Safety Technology, etc.) ① Any person who intends to obtain designation of a new disaster safety technology (hereinafter referred to as “new technology”) pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of the Interior and Safety, in accordance with Paragraph 3 of the same Article, an application for designation of new technology in the form of Annex No. 5, with the following documents attached.

rows.source_ko: 1. Documents describing the development background, history, principles, and feasibility, etc. of the designated technology (hereinafter referred to as “Technology”) in this paragraph
rows.text_en: 1. Documents describing the development background, history, principles, and feasibility, etc. of the designated technology (hereinafter referred to as “Technology”) in this paragraph

rows.source_ko: 2. Documents describing the performance and economic feasibility of the technology
rows.text_en: 2. Documents describing the performance and economic feasibility of the technology

rows.source_ko: 3. Technical Design Drawings and Operational Procedures
rows.text_en: 3. Technical Design Drawings and Operational Procedures

rows.source_ko: 4. Documents describing the applicant's self-evaluation, such as test reports stating evaluation items, frequency, and methods, as well as the types of raw materials, materials, or test materials related to the evaluation.
rows.text_en: 4. Documents describing the applicant's self-evaluation, such as test reports stating evaluation items, frequency, and methods, as well as the types of raw materials, materials, or test materials related to the evaluation.

rows.source_ko: 5. Documents describing the content of the technology (including specific details regarding the gist of the technology and its originality and inventiveness).
rows.text_en: 5. Documents describing the content of the technology (including specific details regarding the gist of the technology and its originality and inventiveness).

rows.source_ko: 6. Record of domestic and international use (only if there is a record of use), documents related to domestic and international patents or certifications (only if patents, etc. exist)
rows.text_en: 6. Record of domestic and international use (only if there is a record of use), documents related to domestic and international patents or certifications (only if patents, etc. exist)

rows.source_ko: 7. Other documents necessary for the designation of new technology as prescribed and notified by the Minister of the Interior and Safety
rows.text_en: 7. Other documents necessary for the designation of new technology as prescribed and notified by the Minister of the Interior and Safety

rows.source_ko: ② Any person who wishes to obtain an extension of the validity period of a new technology designation shall, in accordance with Article 14, Paragraph 3 of the Act , submit an application for extension of the validity period of a new technology designation in the form of Annex 6, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Minister of the Interior and Safety.
rows.text_en: ② Any person who wishes to obtain an extension of the validity period of a new technology designation shall, in accordance with Article 14, Paragraph 3 of the Act, submit an application for extension of the validity period of a new technology designation in the form of Annex 6, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Minister of the Interior and Safety.

rows.source_ko: 1. Documents describing improvements made after the designation of new technology
rows.text_en: 1. Documents describing improvements made after the designation of new technology

rows.source_ko: 2. Documents detailing domestic and international utilization records, field application results, and performance and efficiency following the designation of the new technology
rows.text_en: 2. Documents detailing domestic and international utilization records, field application results, and performance and efficiency following the designation of the new technology

rows.source_ko: 3. Data describing the development status and technological level of similar technologies
rows.text_en: 3. Data describing the development status and technological level of similar technologies

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 신기술 지정의 유효기간 연장을 위하여 필요한 서류로서 행정안전부장관이 정하여 고시하는 서류
rows.text_en: 4. Other documents necessary for extending the validity period of the new technology designation, as prescribed and notified by the Minister of the Interior and Safety

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 또는 제2항에 따른 신청서를 제출받은 행정안전부장관은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서 또는 사업자등록증을 확인해야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 사업자등록증의 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 그 사본을 첨부하도록 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of the Interior and Safety who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 or 2 shall verify the certificate of corporate registration or business registration certificate through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the business registration certificate, a copy thereof must be attached.

rows.source_ko: ④ 행정안전부장관은 영 제12조제2항 또는 제5항에 따라 신기술 지정 또는 지정의 유효기간 연장에 관한 심사를 실시한 경우에는 그 결과를 별지 제7호서식의 평가 결과 등록대장에 기록하고, 다음 각 호에 따른 날까지 보존해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ If the Minister of the Interior and Safety conducts an examination regarding the designation of a new technology or the extension of the validity period of such designation pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 2 or 5 of the Enforcement Decree, he/she shall record the results in the evaluation result registration ledger in the form of Annex 7 and preserve it by the date specified in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 신기술로 지정된 경우 또는 신기술 지정의 유효기간이 연장된 경우: 유효기간 만료일
rows.text_en: 1. In the case of designation as a new technology or extension of the validity period of the new technology designation: Expiration date of the validity period

rows.source_ko: 2. 제1호 외의 경우: 결과통보일부터 5년이 되는 날
rows.text_en: 2. Cases other than Subparagraph 1: The day marking five years from the date of notification of results

rows.source_ko: 제5조(신기술 지정의 심사기간) 영 제12조제2항 후단에서 “행정안전부령으로 정하는 기간”이란 다음 각 호의 기간을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Examination Period for Designation of New Technology) In the latter part of Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “period prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety” refers to the periods of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 신청인이 서류를 보완하는 데에 걸리는 기간
rows.text_en: 1. Time required for the applicant to supplement documents

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 제12조제3항 및 제4항에 따라 이해관계인과 관련 분야 전문기관의 의견을 듣기 위해 필요한 기간
rows.text_en: 2. The period required to hear the opinions of interested parties and specialized institutions in relevant fields pursuant to Article 12, Paragraphs 3 and 4 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 제6조(신기술 지정서 등) ① 법 제14조제4항에 따른 신기술 지정서는 별지 제8호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Designation Certificate for New Technology, etc.) ① The designation certificate for new technology pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 8 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제14조제4항에 따라 신기술 지정서를 발급받은 자는 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 행정안전부장관에게 신기술 지정서의 재발급을 신청할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② A person who has been issued a new technology designation certificate pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 4 of the Act may apply to the Minister of the Interior and Safety for the reissuance of the new technology designation certificate in any of the following cases.

rows.source_ko: 1. 신기술지정서를 잃어버리거나 헐어 못 쓰게 된 경우
rows.text_en: 1. In the case where the New Technology Designation Certificate is lost or damaged to the point of being unusable

rows.source_ko: 2. 기술보유자에 관한 기재사항이 변경된 경우
rows.text_en: 2. If the details regarding the technology holder have changed

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제12조제8항에 따른 신기술 활용실적은 별지 제9호서식에 따라 작성한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The performance record of new technology utilization pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 8 of the Enforcement Decree shall be prepared in accordance with Form No. 9 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ④ 신기술 지정을 받은 자 외에 신기술을 활용한 자는 필요한 경우에는 별지 제9호서식에 따라 신기술 활용실적을 작성하여 행정안전부장관에게 제출할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ④ Persons who have utilized the new technology other than those who have been designated as new technology may, if necessary, prepare a report on the utilization of the new technology in accordance with Form No. 9 attached hereto and submit it to the Minister of the Interior and Safety.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 영 제12조제7항에 따른 신기술 표지는 별표 1에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The new technology mark pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 7 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Annex 1 .

rows.source_ko: 제7조(재난안전제품의 인증 등) ① 법 제16조제1항에 따른 재난안전제품에 대한 적합성 인증(이하 “인증”이라 한다) 또는 인증의 유효기간 연장을 받으려는 자는 같은 조 제3항에 따라 별지 제10호서식에 따른 인증 또는 인증 유효기간 연장신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 행정안전부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Certification, etc. of Disaster Safety Products) ① Any person who intends to obtain certification of conformity for disaster safety products pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “certification”) or an extension of the validity period of such certification shall submit to the Minister of the Interior and Safety, in accordance with Paragraph 3 of the same Article, an application for certification or extension of the validity period of certification in accordance with Form No. 10 of the Annex, attaching the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 인증 대상 제품(이하 이 항에서 “제품”이라 한다)에 대한 설명서
rows.text_en: 1. Description of the product subject to certification (hereinafter referred to as “Product” in this paragraph)

rows.source_ko: 2. 「국가표준기본법」 제23조제2항에 따른 인정기구로부터 인정받은 시험ㆍ검사기관에서 발급한 시험성적서 또는 성능검사 자료(인증 신청의 경우에는 신청일부터 2년 이내에 발급된 것이어야 한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Test reports or performance inspection data issued by a testing or inspection institution accredited by an accreditation body pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 2 of the Framework Act on National Standards (in the case of an application for certification, they must have been issued within two years from the date of application)

rows.source_ko: 3. 다른 법률에 따라 제품에 대하여 사용 전 검사 등을 받아야 하는 경우에는 해당 검사 등을 받았음을 증명하는 자료
rows.text_en: 3. In cases where pre-use inspections, etc. are required for the product under other laws, documents proving that such inspections, etc. have been received

rows.source_ko: 4. 논문 또는 학술지 등 제품 성능의 우수성을 증명하는 자료
rows.text_en: 4. Materials proving the excellence of product performance, such as papers or academic journals

rows.source_ko: 5. 그 밖에 행정안전부장관이 정하여 고시하는 자료
rows.text_en: 5. Other materials determined and notified by the Minister of the Interior and Safety

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청서를 제출받은 행정안전부장관은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 법인 등기사항증명서 또는 사업자등록증을 확인해야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 사업자등록증의 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 그 사본을 첨부하도록 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of the Interior and Safety who receives the application form under Paragraph 1 shall verify the certificate of corporate registration or business registration certificate through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the business registration certificate, a copy thereof must be attached.

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제16조제3항에 따른 인증의 유효기간 연장 신청은 유효기간 만료일의 3개월 전까지 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ An application for an extension of the validity period of certification pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 3 of the Act must be made no later than three months prior to the expiration date of the validity period.

rows.source_ko: ④ 법 제16조제4항에 따른 재난안전제품 인증서는 별지 제11호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ④ The disaster safety product certification pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 11 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 행정안전부장관은 법 제16조제4항에 따라 인증서를 발급받은 자가 영문 인증서의 발급을 요청하는 경우에는 별지 제12호서식에 따른 영문 인증서를 발급할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ If a person who has been issued a certificate pursuant to Article 16, Paragraph 4 of the Act requests the issuance of an English certificate, the Minister of the Interior and Safety may issue an English certificate in accordance with Form No. 12 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 영 제15조제5항에 따른 인증 표지는 별표 2에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The certification mark pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Annex 2 .

rows.source_ko: 제8조(인증제품의 사후관리) ① 행정안전부장관은 법 제17조제1항에 따라 점검을 하려는 경우에는 점검 시작 7일 전까지 점검 일시, 점검자 및 점검내용 등을 점검대상자에게 서면으로 통지해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Post-management of Certified Products) ① When the Minister of the Interior and Safety intends to conduct an inspection pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act, he/she shall notify the subject of the inspection in writing of the date and time of the inspection, the inspector, and the contents of the inspection, etc., at least 7 days before the start of the inspection.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에서 규정한 사항 외에 점검의 방법ㆍ절차에 관하여 필요한 사항은 행정안전부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ② In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraph 1, necessary matters concerning the methods and procedures of inspection shall be determined and announced by the Minister of the Interior and Safety .

rows.source_ko: Article 9 (Support for Startup and Commercialization) ①Any person who wishes to receive support for a startup pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of the Interior and Safety an application for support for a startup in the disaster safety industry in the form of Annex 13 , attaching the documents of each of the following subparagraphs.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Support for Startup and Commercialization) ① Any person who wishes to receive support for a startup pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of the Interior and Safety an application for support for a startup in the disaster safety industry in the form of Annex 13, attaching the documents of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. Business plan (including details verifying the progress of the business and future plans)
rows.text_en: 1. Business plan (including details verifying the progress of the business and future plans)

rows.source_ko: 2. Certificate documents of a start-up enterprise pursuant to Article 39, Paragraph 2 of the Small and Medium Enterprise Start-up Support Act (only applicable if submission is possible)
rows.text_en: 2. Certificate documents of a start-up enterprise pursuant to Article 39, Paragraph 2 of the Small and Medium Enterprise Start-up Support Act (only applicable if submission is possible)

rows.source_ko: ② A person who wishes to receive commercialization support pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of the Interior and Safety an application for commercialization support for the disaster safety industry in the form of Annex 14 , along with a plan for the commercialization of disaster safety technology or disaster safety product (including data that can verify development results).
rows.text_en: ② A person who wishes to receive commercialization support pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of the Interior and Safety an application for commercialization support for the disaster safety industry in the form of Annex 14 , along with a plan for the commercialization of disaster safety technology or disaster safety product (including data that can verify development results).

rows.source_ko: ③ The Minister of the Interior and Safety who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 or 2 shall verify the certificate of corporate registration or business registration certificate through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the business registration certificate, a copy thereof must be attached.
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of the Interior and Safety who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 or 2 shall verify the certificate of corporate registration or business registration certificate through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the business registration certificate, a copy thereof must be attached.

rows.source_ko: ④ The Minister of the Interior and Safety may consult with experts in relevant fields if necessary to examine an application under paragraph 1 or 2.
rows.text_en: ④ The Minister of the Interior and Safety may consult with experts in relevant fields if necessary to examine an application under paragraph 1 or 2.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ If the Minister of the Interior and Safety has selected a recipient of support by reviewing an application under Paragraph 1 or 2, he/she shall notify the applicant of the result.
rows.text_en: ⑤ If the Minister of the Interior and Safety has selected a recipient of support by reviewing an application under Paragraph 1 or 2, he/she shall notify the applicant of the result.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ If the Minister of the Interior and Safety has provided support for costs, etc. pursuant to Article 20 , Paragraph 1 or 2 of the Act , he or she may request the recipient of such support to submit data regarding the results of the startup or commercialization.
rows.text_en: ⑥ If the Minister of the Interior and Safety has provided support for costs, etc. pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 1 or 2 of the Act, he or she may request the recipient of such support to submit data regarding the results of the startup or commercialization.

rows.source_ko: Article 10 (Fees) Fees pursuant to Article 23 of the Act shall be in accordance with the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Fees) Fees pursuant to Article 23 of the Act shall be in accordance with the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. Fees for designation of new technology or extension of the validity period of designation pursuant to Article 23 , Subparagraph 1 of the Act : Attached Table 3

rows.source_ko: ADDENDA <Ministry of the Interior and Safety Decree No. 371, Jan. 3, 2023>
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of the Interior and Safety Decree No. 371, Jan. 3, 2023>

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on January 5, 2023.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on January 5, 2023.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Preservation of the Register of Disaster Prevention Technology Evaluation Results)  Notwithstanding Article 4, Paragraph 4, the former provisions shall apply to the preservation of the register of evaluation results that is recorded and preserved pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 3 of the former Enforcement Rule of the Natural Disaster Countermeasures Act at the time of the enforcement of this Rule.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Preservation of the Register of Disaster Prevention Technology Evaluation Results)  Notwithstanding Article 4, Paragraph 4, the former provisions shall apply to the preservation of the register of evaluation results that is recorded and preserved pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 3 of the former Enforcement Rule of the Natural Disaster Countermeasures Act at the time of the enforcement of this Rule.

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning Designation Certificates for New Technologies)  Designation certificates for new disaster prevention technologies issued prior to the enforcement of this Rule pursuant to Form No. 11 of the former Enforcement Rule of the Natural Disaster Countermeasures Act shall be deemed to be designation certificates for new technologies issued pursuant to Form No. 8.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning Designation Certificates for New Technologies)  Designation certificates for new disaster prevention technologies issued prior to the enforcement of this Rule pursuant to Form No. 11 of the former Enforcement Rule of the Natural Disaster Countermeasures Act shall be deemed to be designation certificates for new technologies issued pursuant to Form No. 8.

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Transitional Measures Concerning Disaster Safety Product Certificates and English Certificates)  ① Disaster safety product certificates issued prior to the enforcement of this Rule pursuant to Form No. 20-7 of the former Enforcement Rule of the Framework Act on Disaster and Safety Management shall be deemed to be disaster safety product certificates issued pursuant to Form No. 11.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Transitional Measures Concerning Disaster Safety Product Certificates and English Certificates)  ① Disaster safety product certificates issued prior to the enforcement of this Rule pursuant to Form No. 20-7 of the former Enforcement Rule of the Framework Act on Disaster and Safety Management shall be deemed to be disaster safety product certificates issued pursuant to Form No. 11.

rows.source_ko: ② An English certificate of disaster safety products issued prior to the enforcement of this rule in accordance with Form No. 20-8 of the former Enforcement Rule of the Framework Act on Disaster and Safety Management shall be deemed to be an English certificate of disaster safety products issued in accordance with Form No. 12.
rows.text_en: ② An English certificate of disaster safety products issued prior to the enforcement of this rule in accordance with Form No. 20-8 of the former Enforcement Rule of the Framework Act on Disaster and Safety Management shall be deemed to be an English certificate of disaster safety products issued in accordance with Form No. 12.

rows.text_en: Article 5 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Natural Disaster Countermeasures Act is amended as follows.
